meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenCode 配置管理多种 AI 模型提供商
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch between AI model providers in containerized environments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按步骤把 OpenCode 后端文件复制进项目、改好配置、安装依赖，然后重建容器镜像。完成后 NanoClaw 的智能体就能改用 OpenCode 运行，从而接入 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等多家模型，不再只能用 Claude。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 的智能体改用 OpenCode（而不是默认的 Claude）作为运行后端时触发，技能会自动完成安装。之后可为每个群组运行 ncl groups config update --provider opencode 切换。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 的智能体后端换成 OpenCode
say.note: 自动复制文件、装依赖并重建镜像。

say.text: 给我接入 OpenRouter 的模型，用 OpenCode 跑
say.note: 装好后按文档配置 .env 和密钥。

say.text: 把群组 my-group 切换到 opencode provider

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude copies the OpenCode provider files, updates config files, installs dependencies, and rebuilds the container image. NanoClaw agents can then use OpenCode as their backend, supporting OpenRouter, DeepSeek, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want NanoClaw agents to run on OpenCode instead of the default Claude backend. After install, switch per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`.

say_en.text: Switch NanoClaw agent backend to OpenCode
say_en.note: Copies files, installs deps, rebuilds image.

say_en.text: Set up OpenRouter models with OpenCode
say_en.note: After install, configure .env and API key.

say_en.text: Switch group my-group to opencode provider
say_en.note: Runs ncl groups config update and restart.
